AWPTCM-T33248.objective:
• The clear arp-cache command removes all dynamic ARP entries from the ARP table while leaving static ARP entries intact.
  • Static ARP entries persist across system restart, failover, and hot-swap events.
  • Static ARP entries are not replaced by dynamic ARP entries.
  • Static ARP entries are not overwritten by gratuitous ARP packets.
  • Static ARP entries maintain correct association with their configured L2 interface and static FDB entry.
  • show arp and related commands accurately reflect static ARP configuration and state.

steps.description: Note: Related ART Tests linked in Traceability. Primary coverage from TestLink AWP-4341 (Static ARP: Command) and related Static ARP suite cases.
Configure a static ARP entry on a VLAN interface. Verify it appears correctly in show arp and is not replaced by dynamic ARP learning.
Remove the static ARP entry and confirm a dynamic ARP entry is learned for the same IP. Re-add the static ARP and confirm the dynamic entry is replaced.
Verify static ARP entries persist across system restart, failover, and hot-swap events.
Send gratuitous ARP packets for a static ARP IP and confirm the static entry is not overwritten.
Verify static ARP entries maintain correct L2 interface association and corresponding static FDB entry.
Test changing the port of an existing static ARP entry and confirm it updates correctly without leaving stale entries.
